name: io.github.liza-studio/skillmem
title: skillmem
description: Self-improving skill memory for coding agents: learn, recall, reinforce, decay — with provenance on every memory and trust only the owner grants. Local SQLite, no API key, no cloud.

environmentVariables.name: SKILLMEM_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite database file (default: the platform data directory)
